copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在使用旧版 tfx-gemini 命令,需要它继续可用。
copy.tagline_en: Redirect the old command to the new tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are using the deprecated tfx-gemini command and need it to keep working.

howto.what: 装上后,tfx-gemini 这个旧命令会被识别为兼容别名,不再直接运行 Gemini CLI,而是把任务转发给 Antigravity 的 agy 命令,通过 tfx-route.sh 以特定参数执行。
howto.when: 当用户使用「tfx-gemini」命令时触发;该名称仅用于兼容旧调用。

say.text: 用 tfx-gemini 帮我总结这份技术文档
say.note: 实际由 Antigravity 的 agy 执行

say.text: tfx-gemini 给这个项目写一份测试计划
say.note: 任务会走 agy --print 通道

howto.what_en: Once installed, the old command "tfx-gemini" is recognized only as a compatibility alias. It no longer runs the Gemini CLI directly; instead, tasks are forwarded to Antigravity's "agy" command via tfx-route.sh with specific flags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user uses the "tfx-gemini" command; this name exists only for legacy compatibility.

say_en.text: Use tfx-gemini to summarize this technical document.
tfx-gemini, write a test plan for this project.
